name: symfony
one_liner: A toolkit for building serious, long-lived websites in PHP, common at European agencies and public institutions.
buyer: A web agency in Europe that builds government or corporate sites on PHP/Symfony contracts.
business_use_cases: An agency builds and maintains government or municipal websites on it, a common requirement in EU public tenders.
A freelancer builds and sells reusable Symfony 'bundles' (packaged modules) to other Symfony shops.
A hosting company offers managed Symfony hosting-and-support plans targeting agencies without in-house DevOps.

money_ideas.idea: Sell reusable Symfony bundles/modules to other development shops
Managed Symfony hosting and support retainer

steal_this: Package a common business need, like invoicing or GDPR consent handling, as a polished Symfony bundle and sell it to other agencies.
